name: cli-generator
description: Generate a complete, production-ready CLI in Bun from a SPEC (OpenAPI, JSON Schema, markdown contract, or natural-language description). Outputs a runnable binary with commander-style arg parsing, shell autocomplete, --help generation, man page, and token-aware output formatting. Use when you need to turn an API spec or feature description into a working CLI in minutes.

findings.excerpt: 4. Output: ready to `npm install -g` or `bun link`
